signature.name: VTask.bitCasesOn
signature.type: {motive : ℕ → Sort u} -> (n : ℕ) -> (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive (Nat.bit b n)) -> motive n

conventions.statement: The natural number n is decomposed as Nat.bit (n.testBit 0) (n >>> 1), so the 'bit' case function is always called with the least-significant bit of n and n right-shifted by one.
conventions.note: This determines what arguments the 'bit' function receives for any given n.

facts.statement: ∀ {motive : ℕ → Sort*} (h : ∀ b n, motive (Nat.bit b n)) (b : Bool) (n : ℕ), VTask.bitCasesOn (Nat.bit b n) h = h b n

facts.statement: ∀ {motive : ℕ → Sort*}, Function.Injective (fun H : ∀ b n, motive (Nat.bit b n) => fun n => VTask.bitCasesOn n H)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {motive : ℕ → Sort*} (H₁ H₂ : ∀ b n, motive (Nat.bit b n)), ((fun n => VTask.bitCasesOn n H₁) = fun n => VTask.bitCasesOn n H₂) ↔ H₁ = H₂
